summary: Validated one causal relationship from the solar, storage, and grid-flexibility idea to Fluence. Storage deployments directly drive its products and backlog, supporting high positive sensitivity, but thin project margins and deeply negative operating cash conversion make shareholder benefit conditional. Accepted the edge at medium confidence and did not escalate to strategy research.
